newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post front - Aug 15.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post front - Aug 15.

text.p: The Washington Post included the following stories on its front page on Aug. 15:
DENVER - Oklahoma City bomber Timothy McVeigh, unrepentant and enigmatic, was formally sentenced to die.
WASHINGTON - A Louisiana law that takes effect Friday makes adultery, abuse, abandonment or a lengthy separation the only acceptable reasons for divorce.

WASHINGTON - The District of Columbia's decision to allow a dump truck driver to continue driving despite numerous traffic violations prompted federal highway officials to begin investigating the city's motor vehicle agency.
WASHINGTON - Footprints left on the sandy shore of a South African lagoon 117,000 years ago have been identified as the oldest fossilized tracks of an anatomically modern human ever found.
JOHANNESBURG - Foreign investment and economic growth rates are on the rise again in South Africa and elsewhere on the continent.
PAGE, ARIZONA - A group of Arizona hikers who died in a flash flood in a stone labyrinth known as Lower Antelope Canyon had no idea they were descending to their deaths.
